methodologyNotes: Roster covers 11 distinct, independently verified electric waffle-maker models spanning Belgian and classic plate formats, from budget mini units to premium multi-program appliances. Specs re-verified against manufacturer product pages (breville.com, hamiltonbeach.com, all-clad.com, gopresto.com, krupsusa.com, chefman.com, blackanddecker.com, bydash.com) and major retailers (Amazon, Walmart, Best Buy, Home Depot, Target). Several manufacturer product pages (cuisinart.com, blackanddecker.com direct model URLs) return 404/blank to automated fetchers, so for those the most reliable retailer/topical source was used as source.url. priceUsd reflects the published US MSRP or manufacturer-site price for the EXACT named model/config; null wattage = not disclosed on any verified manufacturer/retailer spec page (a null beats a guess). boolean specs: true=feature confirmed present, false=confirmed absent; null=not disclosed. accessedAt 2026-06-20. Corrections from the draft: Breville BWM640XL releaseDate 2014->2013; several source/corroboration URLs replaced with working topical pages; low-authority review aggregator (shouldit.com) dropped as corroboration. No products were fabricated; all 11 exist and were retained.

products.name: Breville the Smart Waffle Pro 4 Slice
products.provenance: Breville product page fetched directly: $299.95, 12 browning/color settings (1-12), 4 batter-type programs, LCD that turns orange during cooking, PFOA-free nonstick cast/die-cast aluminum plates (non-removable), 4-square Belgian capacity. Wattage NOT disclosed on manufacturer page or any reliable spec source -> left blank (a search snippet claimed 1800 W but it is not on the Breville page, so not used). release date corrected 2014->2013 (Amazon Date First Available Aug 2013 / launch Oct 2013 per wafflemakercenter).

products.name: Dash Mini Waffle Maker

products.name: Hamilton Beach Flip Belgian Style Waffle Maker with Removable Plates

products.name: Ninja Belgian Waffle Maker PRO NeverStick
products.priceNote: MSRP $99.99 per sharkninja.com official BW1001 product page (the $17.99 shown on the same page is the separate Precision Pour Cup add-on, model 100CU1000). Amazon (B0B358VDZJ) showed no featured offer when checked, so the manufacturer figure is used.
products.provenance: Re-verified against SharkNinja's official BW1001 product page and Amazon B0B358VDZJ, both fetched directly. Both confirm: model BW1001 (Part Number BW1001), 1,000 watts / 120 volts, nonstick "NeverStick" 1-inch Belgian waffle in a unique vertical cooking chamber, 5 shade settings (the exclusive specialty setting for high-sugar batters is separate and not counted as a browning level), and audible & visual alerts (visual alerts read as indicator lights). Price $99.99 is the SharkNinja manufacturer figure; the $17.99 on the same page is the separate PrecisionPour Cup add-on (model 100CU1000), and Amazon showed "No featured offers available" at fetch time. flip rotating is false — both pages describe a stationary vertical design with no flip/rotate mechanism (flip is a headline feature on rival units and is absent here). removable plates is left blank — neither page states plate removability ("Dishwasher Safe: No" addresses only dishwasher use). plate count was removed — neither page states a plate/waffle count; the only "1" present ("1-inch") refers to waffle thickness, not a count, so it could not be verified verbatim. Neither page publishes a release date, so release date is left blank.

products.name: Breville the No-Mess Waffle
products.priceNote: MSRP $169.95 per breville.com product page (listed price "$169.95 / Add to cart")
products.provenance: Adversarially re-verified by re-fetching both pages. Breville manufacturer page confirms the exact model "the No-mess Waffle" (BWM520): price "$169.95" ("Add to cart - $169.95"), a "Classic circular waffle maker", browning control "With 7 settings", the "No mess moat", PFOA-free non-stick coating on Die-Cast Aluminum Cooking Plates, and a "Ready light" that "illuminates when it's ready". Wattage is NOT disclosed on the Breville page, so it was taken from the corroborating retailer. The Amazon listing (ASIN B00M2OI2NY, Part Number 603119-BWM520XL, "Breville BWM520XL No-Mess Classic Round Waffle Maker") confirms the exact BWM520XL model and states Wattage 900 watts (Power: 900 Watts; Voltage 110-120 V), "Browning control dial with 7 color settings" ("Number of settings 7"), PFOA-free non-stick coating, and "Capacity: 1 Classic waffle (approx. 6-5/8\" x 5-5/8\")". flip_rotating=false is supported by an Amazon verified-purchase review ("No having to flip it") and the stationary circular-moat design. removable_plates kept null: no manufacturer spec states removable/fixed status (several Amazon customer reviews mention "the plates are not removable", but that is user-generated, not an official spec, so it was not adopted as a value). releaseDate is not published on either page so it was kept null. Walmart's listing hit a bot-challenge wall and was not used.

products.name: Dash No-Drip Waffle Maker
products.priceNote: Regular price $49.99 on bydash.com official "No-Drip Waffle Maker" page (page SKU DNMWM400AQ; same 12.5x11.3x4.6 in / 6.4 lb unit as the retail DNMWM455SL). Amazon DNMWM455SL US price was geo-blocked ("No featured offers available" / no data), so the manufacturer figure was used.
products.provenance: Re-fetched both URLs (fetch-clean). bydash.com/products/no-drip-waffle-maker confirms the Dash No-Drip Waffle Maker: "4 waffle plates heat in just minutes", "four-at-a-time batches", "Dual nonstick surfaces", built-in pocket/overflow sides, non-slip feet, indicator lights ("signal when cooking surfaces are preheating and ready"), dimensions 4.6x11.3x12.5 in, 6.4 lbs, PTFE nonstick, regular price $49.99, SKU DNMWM400AQ; no wattage, plate style, or browning control listed. Amazon listing for the exact model (Part Number DNMWM455SL, "Deluxe No-Drip Waffle Maker", Silver) gives structured specs: Wattage 1200 watts, 110 Volts, "Number of settings 1" (no browning dial), Aluminum/Carbon Steel/Plastic PFOA-Free, identical 12.5"D x 11.3"W x 4.6"H / 6.4 lb dimensions — same unit as the bydash page. Verified-purchase reviews confirm a ready-indicator light (green when ready) and non-removable plates ("I just wish the plates were removable", "would be super cool if the plates could come out"), so indicator lights=true, removable plates=false, flip rotating=false (no flip/rotate mechanism; "no need to check or flip the waffles"; the Flip Belgian model is a separate product). plate type left blank: manufacturer and Amazon structured specs do not classify it (retailer titles say "Belgian" but a reviewer notes it is "not too thick like most Belgian irons"). browning control levels and release date left blank: no fetched page states a browning-level count or a release date. Amazon price was "No featured offers available"/no data, so bydash's $49.99 USD was used.
